failures.question: premium plan ka price kitna hai
failures.answer: Kaveri Retail does not offer price matching with other websites. If the price of an item drops within 7 days of purchase, Premium customers can request the difference as wallet credit.  [Pricing Discounts and Plans, 6. Price Match, p.1]
